// REQ: LANG-711 LANG-712 LANG-713 LANG-714
    .text
    .global _start

_start:
    mov x0, #1              // stdout
    adr x1, msg
    mov x2, #14
    mov x8, #64             @ write
    svc #0
loop:
    subs w3, w3, #1
    b.ne loop
    ldr r0, [sp, #4]
    str r1, [r2]!
    mov x0, #0x1F
    ret

    .data
msg:
    .ascii "Hello, world!\n"
